name: freepats
character: FreePats: a collection of free instrument sets (piano, guitar, strings, winds, percussion, synths) as SFZ and SF2
licence: different for every set: read the set's page
attribution: FreePats, the named author of each set

all.what: the library as its author publishes it
all.manual_note: Open the page, download the SFZ instrument, then run: sfz_libs.py install-local freepats <downloaded.zip> --project <dir>. Then name it in an instrument preset: "sfz": {"library": "freepats", "patch": "<path/to/patch>"}.
